description: AAASM-5353 negative: hard negatives of the shape the 統一編號 checksum is weakest against. The checksum admits roughly one 8-digit string in five, so the boundary rule is what carries the precision here: eight digits inside a longer run, after a decimal point, or inside a git SHA prefix are fragments of one value and are not reported. (A bare standalone 8-digit date IS a documented residual - see the module docs - and is deliberately absent from this vector.)
